paper.title: Algorithm 907: KLU, a direct sparse solver for circuit simulation problems (Collected Algorithms from ACM)
paper.venue: ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 37(3), Article 36 (2010), per the archive header 907.head and the frame item.
paper.url: https://netlib.org/toms/907.zip (article DOI not verified by scout; ACM page not fetched, 403 risk)

code.commit: netlib TOMS archive 907.zip (C sources in Matlab/KLU/Source and Include, with AMD, COLAMD, BTF and UFconfig in the same tree; the C demo kludemo in Matlab/KLU/Demo; matrices in Matlab/KLU/Matrix)
code.archive: downloaded by scout 2026-11-27 from netlib.org/toms/907.zip (HTTP 200, 1023178 bytes, 234 files). sha256 d01a10366cc289ea803b119ea5f62dfa548867fe12460f9e2c593bab6489dc31 (scout re-downloaded netlib.org/toms/907.zip 2026-11-27, HTTP 200, 1023178 bytes, and matched this hash).
code.note: Build the C demo kludemo from Matlab/KLU/Demo (the archive's Makefile), then run it with the matrix Matlab/KLU/Matrix/w156.mtx on standard input, as the shipped kludemo.out does. The claim is the condest value printed for w156.mtx.

field: numerics (sparse direct linear solvers, circuit simulation)

claim.location: Shipped reference output Matlab/KLU/Demo/kludemo.out, the block for './kludemo < ../Matrix/w156.mtx': the line 'n 156 nnz(A) 362 nnz(L+U+F) 396 resid 6.23816e-08', then 'recip growth 0.00889922 condest 1.79787e+09 rcond 0.000124785 flops 175'. The claimed number is condest = 1.79787e+09.
claim.paper_value: condest 1.79787e+09 for w156.mtx, as printed by the shipped demo output (the paper's own table is not read; the ACM article is not fetched).
claim.metric: condest, the 1-norm condition estimate reported by KLU for the w156 matrix, compared as an absolute number
claim.determinism: deterministic (fixed input matrix, no random numbers in the demo; the estimate uses the factorization only)

tolerance.basis: Fixed before any run. The printed value has 6 significant figures, so its rounding step is 1e4 at this magnitude. 5e4 allows five units of that step and nothing larger. Not to be loosened after any run.

cost.cpu_minutes_estimate: Under 5 minutes: one C build of the KLU demo and one run on a 156-by-156 sparse matrix.
cost.data_size: The matrix w156.mtx is a few kilobytes in the archive.
cost.data_licence: Licence in the archive is LGPL (Doc/lesser.txt); the rerun should record it.

why: The demo runs KLU's factorization and condition estimate on a fixed sparse matrix and prints condest; the number needs the code to run, since no closed form gives it for this matrix. The rerun must build the C library from the archive, not the MATLAB interface.
